meta.notes: An index of topics pointing at the publication that governs each one. Every publication name, date and URL below was read off the document itself: each PDF was fetched from e-Publishing and its number, title and date taken from its own first page, not from memory. 9 of 11 topics are cited. The two still empty are First Sergeant duties and family care plans: the pages they should point at were not found at the numbers tried (36-2113, 36-2618 and 36-2908 under af_a1), so they are left blank rather than guessed. Every "section" is empty on purpose. Naming the right publication only needed its cover page; naming a paragraph inside it needs the paragraph read, and an unread paragraph number is the one field here that would be plausible and wrong. Fill those in as the publications are read, and flip this to verified once the last two topics have a publication.
